headline: ROD WAVE'S CATALOG GETS A MAJOR RIAA UPGRADE
body: Say Cheese TV reports that Rod Wave received 59 new RIAA certifications. The RIAA database confirms a large August 31 batch across his catalog: 'Street Runner' reached 4x platinum; 'Cold December' and 'Alone' reached 2x platinum; and 'Last Lap,' 'Checkmate' and 'Come See Me' reached platinum. Complex separately reported the new awards while noting that Don't Look Down is projected near 102,000 first-week units and could debut at No. 1; final chart results are still pending.
